title: Auslander-Reiten-Serre duality revisited
summary: Let $(\mathcal{C},\mathbb{E},\mathfrak{s})$ be an extriangulated category with a right Auslander-Reiten-Serre (ARS for short) duality $(τ, η)$ in the sense of Iyama, Nakaoka and Palu. We show $(τ, η)$ induces right ARS dualities on the relative theories of $(\mathcal{C},\mathbb{E},\mathfrak{s})$. Under relative structures, we show that the functor $τ$ is indeed an exact functor between extriangulated categories and preserves almost split exangles.
